brief: Prioritise the Vernham Creek 138/13kV transformer for pre-event attention, as its advanced age and loading history reduce its margin against mechanical failure ahead of the heat event. If this unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified.
